fields.page_or_table: Fig. 1A, page 536 (Normal genotype, no infection bar)

items.item_note: In Fig. 1A (1063A/G), the Normal genotype bar shows 106 patients with no infection, 23 with probable IA and 10 with proven IA. A gives 106 and B leaves the field blank.

The death-in-remission curve in Fig. 1C reports only percentages, not counts. B's 106 is the no-infection count for the IA outcome in Fig. 1A, and its p-value of 0.026 also comes from the IA comparison in Fig. 1A.

fields.page_or_table: Fig. 1B, page 536 (Normal genotype, no infection bar)

items.item_note: Fig. 1B reports two p-values: 0.025 for normal genotype vs carrier recipient and 0.006 for normal genotype vs carrier donor. B's 0.025 matches the recipient comparison. A's 0.026 is a value from Fig. 1A (1063A/G), not from this SNP.
The overall survival curve in Fig. 1D reports only percentages, not counts. A's 103 and 0.006 come from the IA incidence comparison in Fig. 1B, not from the survival result.
